patch_description: The crossover combines the placeholder's simple interface with the current program's vectorized simulated-annealing local search, but strengthens it in several ways: (1) a better, more symmetric initial layout (vertices plus interior grid), (2) deterministic multi-start annealing over several fixed seeds, keeping the best configuration, (3) targeted moves that perturb the vertices of the currently-smallest triangle (pushing apart the bottleneck triple) mixed with uniform random moves, (4) a two-phase schedule (coarse exploration then fine refinement) with adaptive step scaling, and (5) a fast, fully vectorized min-area evaluator using precomputed triple indices so runtime stays low. The function is deterministic (fixed seeds), handles degenerate configurations gracefully (returns the best found even if optimization stalls), and returns an (11,2) array clamped inside the unit equilateral triangle.
